texts.Portal_Code_Email_Body:
Your sign-in code for {0} is {1}. It works for {2} minutes.

If you did not ask to sign in, you can ignore this email: nobody can sign in without the code.
texts.Portal_Scope_Capped: A portal page reads at most {0} of a person''s scope records (newest first), so older ones are left out of the page. Narrow the page''s scope conditions if people need them.
texts.Portal_Home_Intro: Your portals and who uses them. People With Access counts active access records across every portal; Signed In counts people who signed in during the last 30 days.
texts.Portal_Home_FirstRunMessage: Create a portal, choose its template and who may sign in, then make it active.
texts.Portal_Home_NoSignIns: No Sign-Ins in the Last 30 Days
texts.Portal_Home_NoSignInsNext: Make a portal active and invite people from its Portal Access list; their sign-ins show here.
texts.Portal_Home_LoadFailed: Portal Builder Home did not load. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
